briefing.headline: OpenAI o4 launch intensifies US-China AGI race as compute shortages bite

sections.label: EXECUTIVE SUMMARY
sections.text: Frontier labs race to deploy next-gen models while regulatory scrutiny mounts. Compute constraints and export controls are reshaping alliances. Multi-agent systems now dominate deployment pipelines.

sections.label: FRONTIER MODELS
sections.text: OpenAI released o4 with 2.4T parameters; Anthropic countered with Claude 4 Opus. Google DeepMind deployed Gemini 3, Meta open-sourced Llama 4.1, while xAI Grok-3 and DeepSeek R2 advanced reasoning benchmarks.

sections.label: SAFETY & SECURITY
sections.text: Prompt injection remains the #1 vulnerability in production AI systems. DialectForge's dynamic dialect negotiation is designed to solve injection at the protocol level for multi-agent, automotive, and IoT deployments.

sections.label: COMPUTE & INFRASTRUCTURE
sections.text: TSMC began volume production of 1.6nm AI chips for NVIDIA Blackwell. Microsoft and Google announced $45B combined data center expansions in Texas and Arizona.

sections.label: STRATEGIC QUESTION
sections.text: Will export controls on advanced chips slow China's AGI timeline more than they accelerate domestic alternatives?
